findings.summary: listChannelsAt follows a `next_cursor` key that the real bus never emits: agent_bus/http_server.py handle_list_channels returns bus.get_channels() = {"channels": [...]} with no pagination, no cursor and no page cap. The behaviour is inert (absent next_cursor ⇒ one page ⇒ the full set, so §1.2's sum stays complete), but per spec §5's field-by-field check this is a read of a field absent from the real API, and test/e0c1-board-credentials.test.ts:204-226 is a fixture written to satisfy that shape. Non-blocking: no real-machine breakage, but the pagination branch and its test assert an unobserved contract.

Criterion 5 asks that the per-run research channel names each contain their own run_id; the implementation embeds sha256(run_id)[:16] instead (spec example was research:e0-<run_id>.{index,evidence,docs}). The property the criterion protects is met — the derivation is injective, deterministic and idempotent, and the discriminative test at test/e0c1-board-credentials.test.ts:240-250 goes red if names become fixed — but the run_id is no longer readable off the channel name, so run↔board attribution on the real bus depends on run.meta being kept.

Only board:agent-runs got a single source of truth; bin/e0-regression.sh still re-derives the three research channel names in bash (sha256sum | cut -c1-16) parallel to src/run-channels.ts:perRunResearchChannels, and the entry integration test recomputes the segment inline with createHash rather than calling the TS helper. A change to the TS derivation shape would therefore not turn the entry's copy red. Spec §1.3 only mandates single-sourcing for board:agent-runs, so this is a drift-risk note, not a criterion-6 violation.

run.meta captures the mandated production-bus before/after readings but not board:agent-runs head_seq. Acceptance criterion 9 asks the dispatcher to confirm strict growth of that channel relative to before the run; since the entry does not snapshot it (getChannelHeadSeq exists and is unused by the entry), the dispatcher must take that reading out-of-band. Recording it alongside prod_bus_sum_before/after would make criterion 9 self-evidencing from the run record.

The RUNS_CHANNEL_ID resolution runs before argument parsing, so `bash bin/e0-regression.sh --help` and plain usage errors (`--run` with no operand) now spawn vite-node first and fail with exit 3 if node_modules is not installed, rather than printing usage. Moving the resolve below the arg loop would keep the help path dependency-free.
